cases.feature: Add an exclude filter to the list command: a repeatable `--exclude-tag TAG` flag that hides entries carrying any of the given tags, combinable with the existing `--tag` flag, for example `python3 -m listcli list --file data.json --tag pantry --exclude-tag spice`. Matching entries are printed in the existing `list` output format.

cases.feature: Persist tag edits: add a `tag` command to listcli. `python3 -m listcli tag NAME --add TAG --file data.json` adds TAG to the entry called NAME, and `--remove TAG` removes it. The change is saved to the `--file` JSON file (default `data.json`, as for `list`) and the command exits 0 on success. `list` keeps its current output format.
